locations.basis: Visible central fortified hub joining the four canal-separated city sectors; city representative, not a district duplicate.
Large western roofed residence inside a rounded enclosure, clearly separate from the concentric memorial near the city.
Open landscaped NW sector/park immediately in front of the gray cruciform cathedral; distinct from the cathedral roof.
Actual broad cruciform gray roof in the NW/central city, identified in the close architectural crop; not the central round hub.
Built-up SW wedge within the curved city waterfront, south of Cathedral Quarter and west of Military District.
Dense NE city block of repeated buildings and courtyards. Rectangular shape is not evidence that this is the prison.
Dense SE city sector, below Merchant Square and east of Greymane Court, using street/canal divisions.
Compact rectangular enclosure below/left of the SE military roofs. Correct district is known, but this exact yard is a candidate, not a uniquely identified prison building.
Actual wooden waterfront dock group at the western bend of the Northgate sea channel, rather than inland terrain.
Main dense intact SW coastal town block. Whole-town context bounds include its western harbor, not just one roof or the old generic terrain pin.
Distinct enclosed cultivated/garden tract south of Duskhaven, west of the adjacent stable-like compound. Orchard identity is a contextual reconstruction; tree species are not visible.
Elongated roof-and-yard compound immediately east of the southern planted enclosure, consistent with the stated orchard/stables relation. Stable function not uniquely visible.
Small separately outlined built waterfront island/parcel directly south of the town, with dock-like projections. Fishery name is a candidate; adjacent compounds can be confused in this dark render.
Real parallel-row cultivated plot north of the restored town. Corn-farm candidate, not a proven named property; custom geography does not reproduce the wiki west/downhill relation precisely.
Real road-loop roof-and-yard clearing south of the cultivated-plot candidate. Farm-name/livestock identification unresolved; not a canonical surveyed Allen location.
Three visible brown roofs on the mainland beside the Northgate River below the NE rocky slopes; old transformed point fell too far east.
Dark timber-like feature against the rock face immediately beside the river village. Best visible entrance candidate; portal identity and exact mine bounds not independently confirmed.
Actual southern coastal fishing-village roof concentration, connected to the pier/causeway, rather than a generic shore point.
Representative actual dark woodland west/southwest of the giant tree and north of the coastal village; an area pin, not a precise forest border.
Huge ochre branching inland tree in its rocky pocket; selects the visible tree itself, not nearby shoreline vegetation.
Distinct elongated gray-roofed roadside building on the southern forest edge north of Stormglen. Mill identity is not visually diagnostic; nearby smaller structure is an alternative.
Elongated visible mainland building/lighthouse candidate on the eastern road and rocky coast. Does not use the bare offshore island or Galewatch beacon.
Pale central monument of the clearly concentric cemetery/memorial enclosure west of Gilneas City. Distinct morphology from the western manor.
Visible dark woodland west of the upper river, between the capital road and water; representative forest terrain, not a village rooftop.
Actual water in the upper diagonal Northgate River channel beside the village. Intentionally a water marker, not a land-only placement.
Rugged mainland high ground on the eastern/right side of the coastal outlet, southeast of the northern offshore beacon island.
Actual western rocky/yellow-green coastal projection opposite the northern headland and northwest of Keel Harbor.
Compact actual village of dark roofs immediately south/southeast of the bluff keep; excludes its southern ponds.
Pale masonry walls, towers and roofed fortress on the western Silverpine coastal bluff, distinct from the village below.
Principal eastern Silverpine road-loop building/sawmill-like group; registration gives a consistent nearby anchor.
Open paved main plaza within the enlarged complete purple/gold custom city. Manually overrides the old crater transformation.
Prominent rectangular pale-framed roof/courtyard building inside the lake-island fortress, not an arbitrary island point.
Open grass on the southern island extension; spatially separate from the fortress marker and clear of the shoreline.
Actually visible square-roofed building in the clipped city near the top edge. Replaces the negative-y transformed old capital point.
Registered northern Silverpine forest-region representative within the visible mainland woodland; regional, not a building or political boundary.
Clearly open lake water southeast of Fenris Isle, west of the southern small islands; intentionally not moved onto land.
Registered legacy site on the rocky rim of the brown forest fissure. Actual braced mine portal is not resolved; do not substitute the timber-looking shoreline structures by enlarged Dalaran.
Actual compact stone tower/beacon on the isolated steep northern rocky island. Explicitly rejects the erroneous old east-coast coordinate.

Prominent large gold-rimmed violet dome/tower in the north-central monumental cluster of the enlarged custom city. Canonical Citadel association is not uniquely readable from this unlabelled vignette; distinct from the city-plaza marker.

notes: Coordinate origin is upper left of the untouched supplied 3526x4548 raster; x increases right and y increases down. Do not multiply coordinates for the parent 1.5x enhancement.

Coordinates are exact integer marker choices, NOT claims of one-pixel geographical certainty. Confidence describes this marker association with the visible site, not canonical historical existence/ownership.
All 39 canonical IDs and source names are retained. This scratch review changes no owners, factions, descriptions, lore, provenance, or historical phase.

The new and old common raster terrain register approximately x+22,y-294, not generic width/height scaling. Custom Dalaran, restored SW town and wrong legacy minor points require manual visual overrides.
Confidence low: Stoneward Prison exact yard; Hayward Fishery island identification; Hammond/Allen farm-name assignments; Emberstone Mine portal; Bradshaw Mill building; Deep Elem Mine portal.

Confidence medium: Violet Citadel exact named building in custom Dalaran; orchard/stable function; Tempest Reach exact building. These are best terrain-backed candidates, not recovered canonical plans.

Parent registration.json: 1259 matches,1217 inliers,median0.312077px,p951.355093px. Independent review SIFT:2458 matches,2382 inliers,median0.374817px,p951.556092px; agreement on near-unit scale/crop shift.
Bounds use [left,top,right,bottom] in source pixels and are visual context envelopes, not ownership polygons or authoritative surveyed extents.
Wiki pages were consulted only for localization relationships, not to import late owners/events. URLs and numbered task-local citations are recorded in coordinates-review.md.
Full numbered annotation: coordinates-review-annotated.jpg; detailed inspection sheet: coordinates-review-details.jpg. Colors: yellow high, cyan medium, magenta low.
